text: If you truly want to show your woman that you respect her, don't listen to a damn word she says. Because every man who's ever been in a relationship understands that every suggestion, question, or idea that comes out of a woman's mouth is absolute lunacy. Babe, would you still love me if I was a worm? Does that sound like a human with the mental stability to make their own choices? Hell no! So do what's best for her in the future, because if you listen to all her suggestions, it just validates her emotions in the moment and doesn't take into consideration five minutes from now. Look, I call out women on this channel when they say ridiculous things. You've probably seen that many times. But we should also be fair and understand that there are plenty of men out there who can say even more ridiculous stuff. And this video is a perfect example of that. The guy says that if you truly respect your woman, you shouldn't listen to a single word she says. That every suggestion or idea that comes out of a woman's mouth is lunacy. Now let's think about this for a second. Imagine we actually take his frame seriously. Imagine he is with a woman who constantly says nonsense. Every idea she has is irrational. Every suggestion is crazy. Then the obvious question is, why would you be with such a woman in the first place? You chose her. Nobody forced you. If she's truly that strange, that irrational, that unstable, and you still decided to build a relationship with her, then the real question is about your own judgment. Because if she's weird and you still went for it, then you might be even weirder. Now let's look at the second possibility. Maybe the woman is actually a normal, reasonable person. And the problem is that you simply classify everything she says as lunacy. In that case, the issue is not her. The issue is you. Because if everything a woman says automatically sounds like nonsense to you simply because she's a woman, then honestly, you are a disgrace to our gender. Imagine someone saying, every idea coming from a man is nonsense. If you are not a hypocrite, you would immediately see how ridiculous that sounds. Guys, relationships are actually very simple in one sense. You should treat women the way you want to be treated yourself. If you want a respectful woman, be respectful. If you want an empathetic woman, be empathetic. If you want a woman who listens to what you say, then you should also listen to what she says. That doesn't mean you have to agree with everything. It doesn't mean you blindly follow every emotional suggestion. But it does mean you treat your partner like someone whose thoughts and opinions matter.
